note: A vocabulary of full-body dance moves, mostly breaking, with a few hip hop foundations, popping, locking and krump moves. check: sourced = the move is named with a description in a source; name_only = named in a source with no description (what it is must be looked up); knowledge = general knowledge. Descriptions are written in my own words after the sources. Seconds are typical lengths of a move where known.

categories.label: Toprock
categories.text: Standing steps: the opening of a set, and the way back to it from other elements. Draws on popping, locking, tap, house.

categories.label: Go-downs (drops)
categories.text: The way from standing to the floor; ideally it flows out of the toprock.

categories.label: Footwork (downrock)
categories.text: Movement on the floor with the hands supporting the body as much as the feet.

categories.label: Freezes: ground
categories.text: Held shapes with the body off the floor on the arms, landed on a strong sound; they often end a sequence.

categories.label: Freezes: air
categories.text: Held shapes with the body up in the air (handstand family and kicks).

categories.label: Power moves
categories.text: Continuous rotation or flipping on the upper body (hands, elbows, head, back, shoulders), with the legs building the momentum.

categories.label: Floats
categories.text: Moves that hop or walk on the hands in a held balance.

categories.label: Spins
categories.text: Rotation about the vertical axis on one point of contact (head, back, elbow, hand, knee).

categories.label: Tricks and others
categories.text: Acrobatic moves, connections and standard moves with an unusual twist.

categories.label: Standing hip hop foundations
categories.text: The bounce and rock under almost every standing hip hop move.

categories.label: Popping and locking (body)
categories.text: Full-body moves of popping, waving, gliding and locking.

flow.note: A set usually opens with toprock, drops to the floor with a go-down, then works footwork and power moves, and ends on a freeze that lands on a strong beat; freezes can be chained into stacks; in blow-up style power moves are chained fast and end in a freeze or a suicide (a move that looks like losing control). Toprock is also the way back to standing.

edges.note: a go-down (drop) is the transition from toprock to the floor

flow.source: Wikipedia: Breakdancing (the links between toprock, drops, footwork, power moves and freezes); the edges between the other categories are my reading and need checking

moves.label: Indian step
moves.text: A basic toprock step that travels with a crossing step and a hop, the arms swinging with it.
moves.source: Red Bull: the basic elements of breaking (named); the description is mine

moves.label: Cross step
moves.text: A toprock step in which one foot crosses over the other and back.
moves.source: Red Bull: the basic elements of breaking (named); the description is mine

moves.label: Kick step
moves.text: A toprock step that kicks one leg out in front on the beat and swaps legs.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Side rock
moves.text: Weight rocks from foot to foot with a small step to the side on each beat.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Uprock (Brooklyn)
moves.text: The standing, face-to-face dance of Brooklyn: quick rhythmic steps and arm swings, often a battle in itself.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Breakdancing (uprock is named as a source of toprock); the description is mine

moves.label: Six-step
moves.text: The foundational footwork: a six-count loop of the legs around the supporting hands, one hand or both on the floor.
moves.source: Red Bull: the basic elements of breaking and Wikipedia: Breakdancing (the foundational footwork move); the detail is my reading

moves.label: Leghop

moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Rocket
moves.text: A six-step into a helicopter, then a high jump with the leg swinging under.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Rolls
moves.text: From four points, a kick into a bent-leg handstand and a drop into a crab.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Skyscraper

moves.label: Solar eclipse
moves.text: Balanced on one hand and bouncing in circles.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Threading
moves.text: A leg threaded through the arms; it is similar to the leghop and often used in freezes.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Valdez
moves.text: From sitting, the arms swing behind and the dancer backflips.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Back to back
moves.text: A two-person move: one dancer flips over the other's back and lands.
moves.source: Wikipedia: List of breakdance moves (2007 mirror)

moves.label: Bounce
moves.text: A rhythmic bend of the knees on every beat, the chest and head following: the pulse under hip hop.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Rock
moves.text: Weight shifting from foot to foot on the beat, with the bounce.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Step touch
moves.text: A step to the side and a touch of the other foot, in time.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Groove
moves.text: A loose, personal bounce with the shoulders and arms, the base of freestyle.
moves.source: general knowledge

moves.label: Pop (hit)
moves.text: A quick contraction and release of the muscles that jerks the body.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance)

moves.label: Tutting
moves.text: Geometric positions of the arms, hands and wrists, mostly right angles.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) / Tutting

moves.label: Wave
moves.text: A wave that travels through the body, arms or hands.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) (waving is named); the description is mine

moves.label: Strobing
moves.text: Stop-motion stutter of the movement, as under a strobe light.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) (named); the description is mine

moves.label: Robot
moves.text: Stiff, mechanical movement in angles and holds.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Hip-hop dance (named); the description is mine

moves.label: Glide (backslide, moonwalk)
moves.text: A slide across the floor that looks like walking the other way.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance) (the backslide, often called the moonwalk)

moves.label: Boogaloo
moves.text: Circular, rolling movement of the hips, chest, shoulders, knees and head.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance)

moves.label: Animation
moves.text: Rigid, jerky movement like a stop-motion character.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Popping (dance)

moves.label: Lock
moves.text: A sudden pause, like a freeze, in the middle of a fast move.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance) / Hip-hop dance

moves.label: Point (locking)
moves.text: One arm extends quickly from the opposite shoulder and is held briefly.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance)

moves.label: Stop and go
moves.text: A locking move of freezes and fast bursts, with a punch.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance)

moves.label: Knee drop (locking)
moves.text: A drop to the knee in locking.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance)

moves.label: Leo walk
moves.text: A locking walk; the source gives no description of it.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance)

moves.label: Scoobot
moves.text: Arms crossed, then the wrists twirl and the hands clap behind the back.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Locking (dance)

moves.label: Stomp
moves.text: The foot driven into the ground and back up, as if the energy comes from the floor.

moves.label: Jab

moves.label: Chest pop
moves.text: An upward chest motion like breathing in.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping

moves.label: Arm swing
moves.text: A sweeping arm movement that uses gravity, small like a pitch or big like a bat.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping

moves.label: Buck hop
moves.text: A krump move named in the article, without a description there.
moves.source: Wikipedia: Krumping
